digest.component_or_area: agentic execution path, prompt caching settings
propositions: On the agentic execution path, tool-result message history is re-sent uncached every turn, causing input cost to grow O(N^2) with accumulated turns.

cache_settings_for() sets only two of four available cache breakpoints (anthropic_cache_instructions and anthropic_cache_tool_definitions), leaving anthropic_cache and bedrock_cache_messages unused despite being available in pydantic-ai 1.107.1.
The telemetry predicate warn_if_cache_ineffective never fires because the system block hits cache, masking the uncached message-tail cost from usage logs.
Anthropic and Bedrock require different cache control keys (anthropic_cache vs bedrock_cache_messages respectively); automatic top-level cache_control is rejected by Bedrock.

Multi-turn agentic runs measured before the fix show flat cache_read (1,240 tokens per call, system only) while uncached input climbs O(N); after enabling message-tail caching, cache_read grows monotonically with history and uncached input collapses.
Single-turn paths must remain byte-identical to prevent regression; the fix must be scoped to execution_mode="agentic" only.
